# ShortKeys

> ShortKeys is a text expansion keyboard for iPhone and iPad. Save the things you type on repeat behind short triggers and drop them into any app with a few taps.

Available now on the App Store.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone and iPad, iOS 26.1 or later
- Price: free with 10 ShortKeys; a one-off tip adds 5 more; the Annual plan (£7.99 a year) unlocks unlimited ShortKeys
- Privacy: data stays on the device and in the user's own iCloud; the developer collects no data
- Developer: Mat Benfield (thechelsuk), made in the UK

## Links

- [ShortKeys website](https://shortkeys.thechels.uk/): the official marketing site
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/shortkeys-text-expansion/id6755919256): download the app
- [Privacy policy](https://thechels.uk/app/privacy): what the app does and does not collect
- [Project page](https://thechels.uk/projects/shortkeys): background from the developer

## Features

- Custom keyboard that expands snippets in any app
- Multi-line snippets for emails, addresses, replies and code
- iCloud sync across iPhone and iPad
- Tags, search and a one-tap favourites bar
- Deep links and Apple Shortcuts support

## FAQ

### What is a text expander?

A text expander lets you type a short trigger, like addr, that instantly expands into longer text, like your full postal address, so you stop typing the same things over and over.

### Does ShortKeys work in every app?

Yes. ShortKeys is a custom iOS keyboard, so your snippets are available in any app where you can type.

### How much does ShortKeys cost?

It's free to download with 10 ShortKeys included. A one-off tip adds 5 more, and the Annual plan at £7.99 a year unlocks unlimited ShortKeys and the one-tap favourites bar.

### Is my data private?

Yes. Everything stays on your device and in your own iCloud account. The developer collects no data from the app.

### Which devices are supported?

iPhone and iPad running iOS 26.1 or later.
